note: Budget for `node scripts/package-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of an app built from each fixture in fixtures/packages, TanStack included, minus the empty app. `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes`. Ceilings guard against silent drift: a check above one fails. A deliberate growth raises the budget (and the ceiling when needed) in the same change, with a one-line reason in `history`.
